components.heading: Amendments – Generally.
components.text: The amendments to the IECC adopted herein shall be set out in this chapter. All references to section and chapter numbers shall be construed as if followed by the words “of the International Energy Conservation Code,” unless clearly indicated otherwise. (Ord. 20343 § 4, 2-15-22.)
